blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The defense panel of Vice President Sara Duterte submitted on Tuesday supposed sub judicious statements made by private prosecutors. Lead defense counsel Sheila Sison made the manifestation before the Senate impeachment court invoking a prior ruling, which prohibits all parties to talk about the merits of all impeachment articles, including those that were withdrawn by the prosecution. “We will provide the clerk of court with a copy of the link of sub judice statements made by private prosecutors… These statements not only go into fair comment.
